description: This file defines the TagRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository to provide CRUD operations for Tag entities, along with custom query methods for finding tags by name, id, and retrieving all tags with associated books.

classes.name: TagRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Tag entities, providing database access and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByName
methods.description: Finds a Tag entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Tag by its ID with an entity graph to fetch associated books.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Tag entities with their associated books.
